contentPattern.structure: head row with title + intro; one row per field: label | type | field name | options; final row with privacy notice + submit label

suitableFor: report download or event registration forms in a dialog (modal variant)
notSuitableFor: forms that need a connected backend submission

description: Shows a lead form with title, intro, a two-column field grid, privacy notice and submit, usually as a dialog opened by contact-sales links, for capturing sales leads.
